content:
- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially >0.53) — model tends to overshoot and fail to correct quickly.
- Underestimate during prolonged negative sentiment (sentiment <0.27) — model misses downward momentum.
- Lag in response to recent price drops — model often holds too high for 2–3 days after a dip.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects after sharp spikes, then underreacts to subsequent pullbacks.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate in early part of forecast window if sentiment is rising; underestimate if sentiment is falling.
- Sentiment correlation: when sentiment is high (0.53+), model should be slightly more conservative; when low (0.27–0.36), model should be more aggressive to avoid missing downside.
